operations.description: Acquire TCSPC, fit triexponentials and report mean lifetime. Use PicoQuant LDH-P-C-405B pulsed excitation, wide-field illumination and neutral-density attenuation. The stated optical-power regime is several nW to hundreds of pW, not exact interval endpoints. Collect through a 100×, NA 1.3 oil-immersion objective, dichroic and long-pass filter; use Perkin-Elmer SPCM-AQR-14 SPAD and PicoQuant PicoHarp 300 TCSPC. Igor Pro fits triexponential histograms and computes the reported average lifetime from amplitude and lifetime coefficients. The eighteen rows report mean fit coefficients and mean average lifetimes for four core sizes. Amplitude coefficients are normalized, but displayed rounding and averaging need not reproduce exact unity or exact average lifetime from the printed mean coefficients. Initial guesses strongly affect individual components, less the converged mean lifetime. Missing fields: raw fit files.
